mil7.2.8:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, cāpassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban ti yaṃ vedesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.2.8:1.2: Yathā mahārāja cāpo sutacchito mito yāv' aggamūlaṃ samakam-eva anunamati na paṭitthambhati,
mil7.2.8:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena thera-nava-majjhimasamakesu anunamitabbaṃ na paṭippharitabbaṃ.
mil7.2.8:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja cāpassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.2.8:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Vidhura-Puṇṇakajātake: Cāpo
